brief:
A gathering in Bethlehem has demanded the publication of a presidential decree to establish a Palestinian industrial union and separate industry from commerce, Ma'an Wire reported. The meeting participants pressed for the formal issuance of the decree, which would create an independent body to represent and organize the industrial sector.

The call reflects efforts within Palestinian economic circles to restructure governance of manufacturing and production separate from trade operations, potentially aimed at strengthening industrial policy and sector representation.
title: Bethlehem meeting calls for presidential decree on Palestinian industrial union
